title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle - Theatrical Trailer
description: A first look at the Infinity Castle story, where the Demon Slayer Corps faces its biggest fight yet. The film continues the story from the series and heads toward its final battles.

title: Inside MAPPA's action animation: A director interview
description: The directors and animators talk about how they plan and create the fast-moving fight scenes in Chainsaw Man and Jujutsu Kaisen.

title: Anime Pulse Weekly: The Greatest Shonen Arcs of All Time
description: In this episode, Kenji and Hiro revisit the Marineford War, the Chimera Ant arc, and the Shibuya Incident, talking through what makes each one work.

title: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree - Launch Trailer
description: The trailer follows the journey into the Land of Shadow, where Miquella's path leads players toward the secrets of Queen Marika and the realm's past.

title: Hidetaka Miyazaki on Difficulty, Wonder, and World Design
description: Hidetaka Miyazaki talks about difficulty, exploration, and how the worlds in FromSoftware games encourage players to keep looking around.

title: Respawn Point: Next-Gen Graphics Engines vs. Art Direction
description: Dave and Sarah compare the newest rendering tools with hand-painted visual styles, and talk about why a game's art direction can matter more than its technical specs.

title: Dune: Part Two - Official Final Theatrical Trailer
description: Paul joins Chani and the Fremen on Arrakis as he faces the people responsible for his family's fall and the choices waiting ahead.

title: Avengers: Secret Wars - Concept Preview
description: A short concept preview imagines the multiverse coming apart and the heroes being drawn into Battleworld.

description: Artists bring together several of the film's different animation styles in a fan-made tribute to the worlds of Gwen, Miles, and Spider-Man India.

description: The teaser reunites the Hawkins group as they prepare to face Vecna and the threat coming from the Upside Down.

description: Marcus and Chloe talk about the character choices and story turns in House of the Dragon and The Last of Us that stay with viewers after an episode ends.

description: A short prologue sets the mood for BTS's next chapter, bringing all seven members together ahead of the planned album and tour.

description: The first look introduces David Corenswet as Superman and offers a glimpse of the new DC film's take on the Man of Steel.
